patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Gong's shape. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans email-outreach, prospecting; Gong leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning email-outreach, prospecting vs Gong-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need Gong's motion (Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
